semantics.label: Modo de reprodución
semantics.details: Select the layout of the player.

options.label: Minimalistic: Shows a simplified player with the essential playback controls.
Full: Shows the complete audio player, including playback controls, progress and volume controls.
Transparent: The controls are hidden, but a hover effect shows the playback area can be clicked to play the sound.

semantics.label: Axustar ao marco
semantics.details: Makes the audio player fill the available width of its container.

semantics.label: Permitir controles
semantics.details: Controls allow the user to for instance pause the audio

semantics.label: Permitir reprodución automática
semantics.details: With autoplay, the audio starts playing automatically. Autoplay may not be supported by all browsers.

semantics.label: Mensaxe de audio non soportado
semantics.default: O teu navegador non permite reproducir este tipo de audio
